versions.changelog:
- Improved district-level location privacy by clarifying that reverse-geocoding reduces coordinates to ~1 km precision before transmission.
- Updated documentation and privacy notes for location handling in SKILL.md.
- Replaced and updated one metadata/support file (_meta.json added, skill-card.md removed).
- Minor corrections and clarifications in privacy, configuration, and setup instructions across reference and script files.

ninebot-show-skill 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Provides secure, read-only access to Ninebot/九号 electric vehicle status and ride reports using a local ninecli session.
- Supports querying battery, range, charging state, smart-service days, location (with privacy controls), ride history, monthly/today stats, and static visualizations (maps, ride tracks).
- Emphasizes user privacy—never requests or handles login credentials, tokens, or sensitive IDs; offers configurable location precision.
- Requires local POSIX shell, Python 3, network, and ninecli 0.1.7 for operation.
- Optional AMap key enables Chinese-language location and map output.
- Includes setup and usage instructions for safe, private operation.
